description: Create accounts from suggested email domains. Each domain becomes an account (externalId and domain set to the domain, name derived from it) with the domain's contacts that belong to no account as members. When one account already uses the domain, contacts are added to it; with several, the domain is skipped (multiple_accounts). A domain whose contacts already partly belong to another account is skipped (already_in_account); domains without eligible contacts are skipped (no_contacts). Up to 25 domains per call; personal, disposable and the workspace's own sending domains are rejected. Keeps existing roles, runs no sync rules or segment-entered sequences, and a retry does not duplicate accounts or members; truncated means contacts were left out because an account holds at most 5,000 members. Fails with a 409 error while contacts use a custom attribute named `account` or `account.*`.
